types.name: AtlasClient

description.summary: A disposable asynchronous client for the fictional Atlas API.
Fetch a document, supporting caller cancellation.

types.name: Document

description.summary: An immutable record returned by the API.

types.declaration: public sealed record Document(string Id, string Title, DocumentState State);

types.name: DocumentState

description.summary: The publication state of a document.

types.declaration: public enum DocumentState { Draft, Published, Archived }
